summary.intent: Investigate the someguy IPFS sidecar state on staging, diagnose performance issues, and upgrade Kubo to v0.40.0 with proper CI/release configuration.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed that someguy's IPNS endpoint is completely non-functional (hangs indefinitely), upgraded Kubo from v0.34.0 to v0.40.0 (validated with 83 E2E + 9,100 load test ops, zero errors), fixed Grafana Cloud 503 provisioning failures, and updated release-please config to trigger releases on `build` commits.

repo: Someguy's /routing/v1/providers/ works fine but /routing/v1/ipns/ hangs indefinitely — IPNS operations are completely broken on someguy v0.11.1
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://someguy:8190 is set in both .env.staging on the VPS and hardcoded in deploy-staging.yml (line 397), so deploy always resets it
docker/ directory (docker-compose.staging.yml, Caddyfile, etc.) lives in the repo at /Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/docker/ and is committed to git
Release-please default config only triggers releases for `feat` and `fix` commits — `build` and `chore` are silently skipped
The `THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET` env var must be set for load/E2E tests to bypass rate limiting; there is no NODE_ENV=test relaxation — throttle limits are hardcoded
Grafana Cloud free-tier instances sleep when idle and return 503 'Your instance is loading' on wake — provisioning steps need a readiness poll before dashboard push
Someguy v0.11.1 is actually ahead of the latest stable release (v0.11.0) — no upgrade path available
Kubo v0.40.1 is a Windows-only bugfix (Go toolchain downgrade for overlapped I/O crash) — not applicable to Linux deployments

code.finding: Default DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL fallback is https://delegated-ipfs.dev when env var is not set
Throttle bypass via X-Throttle-Bypass header checked against THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET env var — no NODE_ENV=test path
Load test records success:false on thrown exceptions; high error rates can mask whether HTTP layer is healthy
Code comment references DHT propagation via Someguy
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://someguy:8190 hardcoded in deploy workflow — overrides any manual .env.staging changes on VPS
Added changelog-sections config to include build commits as releasable — previously only feat and fix triggered releases

workflow: vitest --testPathPattern can match multiple test files unintentionally if pattern is too broad, causing all scenarios to run concurrently and interfere with each other
When .env file has NODE_ENV=development, NestJS ConfigModule overrides shell environment — must edit .env directly to change NODE_ENV for local testing
CodeRabbit's release summaries can be misleading — always verify changelog details directly (v0.40.1 described as 'stability improvements' was actually Windows-only)
git amend + force push is needed when changing commit type to trigger release-please, but requires care to not lose review thread context on open PRs

friction: Someguy 'disable' from a previous session never persisted — likely edited .env.staging directly on VPS which was overwritten by subsequent deploy resetting to compose defaults

Load test harness marks all operation exceptions as errors but tests still 'pass', masking a 95%+ functional failure rate — required manual API log inspection to find root cause (delegated routing timeouts)
NODE_ENV=test has no effect on throttle limits; test harness requires THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET which has no documentation in the SDK E2E test directory
Release-please silently skipped the build commit with no clear error — only discoverable by reading job logs carefully ('No user facing commits found')
vitest testPathPattern matched sustained-load.test.ts alongside mixed-workload.test.ts causing concurrent 5-minute tests that generated Cloudflare 522 errors
open_items: Someguy IPNS is broken — decision pending on whether to remove it, switch DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL back to delegated-ipfs.dev, or investigate root cause further
Post-phase-19 performance baselines not yet collected — waiting for latest deploy to land on staging before running load tests against someguy
Kubo v0.40.0 branch merged to main but release-please config fix (build commit type) is on a separate branch not yet merged — release not yet triggered
TEE Worker still uses delegated-ipfs.dev directly (not routing through someguy) — noted as architectural inconsistency but not addressed
Load test THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is not documented in tests/load — engineers running load tests locally will hit 429s without knowing why
